expo.name: SideQuest ATX
expo.description: Photograph every broken, blocked, or missing sidewalk in Austin. Location-locked capture for the SideQuest ATX map.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: During a Glasses Walk, SideQuest keeps a GPS trail while your phone is in your pocket so photos taken with your glasses can be placed on the map. It stops when you end the walk.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: SideQuest uses motion activity to keep the GPS trail accurate while you walk and to rest the GPS when you stand still.

NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti.PreciseCapture: SideQuest needs precise location so a hazard photo lands on the exact sidewalk panel, not just the block.

plugins.cameraPermission: SideQuest uses the camera to photograph sidewalk hazards for the public map.
plugins.microphonePermission: SideQuest does not record audio. This permission is only used if you choose to record a short video of a hazard.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SideQuest records where each sidewalk photo is taken so it lands on the right panel on the map.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: During a Glasses Walk, SideQuest keeps a GPS trail while your phone is in your pocket so photos taken with your glasses can be placed on the map. It stops when you end the walk.

plugins.photosPermission: SideQuest reads photos taken with your glasses during a walk so they can be placed on the map.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: SideQuest saves each hazard photo, with its location, to a SideQuest ATX album so you always keep a copy.

plugins.photosPermission: SideQuest lets you pick a photo of a sidewalk hazard from your library.
plugins.cameraPermission: SideQuest uses the camera to photograph sidewalk hazards for the public map.
